parsed.post: KEEP: DEPTH 6 + all shards (0-10) dropped val_bpb from 0.8926 to 0.8635! The increased capacity is paying off significantly. Next, I'll adopt agent-9's strategy of halving the batch size to 262144 to maximize optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, while also adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize the training.
parsed.description: Stacking DEPTH=6, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144, and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on top of the all-shard configuration.
